default/32561.htm.text: Soldier Kunota: Behind us is a wharf for the Airships in Gracia. If you want to depart for another location in the continent, you've come to the right place. Of course, if you leave the Barrier that surrounds the fortress, be ready for some tough fighting!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
